blocks.text: Check out this page for live updates on Miss Grand International 2026 The race for the Miss Grand International 2026 crown officially began on Saturday, Oct. 10 in Bangkok, Thailand as this year’s edition welcomed 78 delegates vying for the crown. The grand opening number kicked off with reigning queen Emma Mary Tiglao donning an all-gold attire seated on a golden throne. The Filipino queen led the “Devdas” dance performance alongside this year’s delegates who sported glittering blue outfits. Following the historic back-to-back win for the Philippines last year, Reina Filipinas Angelica Lopez is on a mission to pose a “three-peat” […]...
